While the popular Keeneland-based trainer has enjoyed 13 winners at Royal Ascot, success on the Knavesmire has proved elusive, having saddled Acapulco to finish second in 2015 and come even closer two years later through Lady Aurelia, with Frankie Dettori memorably celebrating passing the post only to find he had actually been beaten a nose by Marsha. Bacio was the 3/1 favourite to go one better under Juan Hernandez following a brilliant victory in the Palace of Holyroodhouse at the Royal meeting in June and pre-race concerns about the rain-softened ground soon proved unfounded as the three-year-old flew out of the starting stalls. messages.text: Chelsea to host Shakhtar's Champions League home games amid ongoing exile

metadata.summary: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their Champions League home games at Stamford Bridge this season after coming to an agreement with Chelsea to host their European matches while they remain in exile from their Donbas Arena home.
metadata.content: Why are Shakhtar playing at Chelsea? Stamford Bridge to host exiled Ukrainian side's Champions League home games | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Why are Shakhtar playing at Chelsea? Stamford Bridge to host exiled Ukrainian side's Champions League home games Shakhtar Donetsk to play Champions League home campaign at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge for 2026/27 season; Ukrainian champions will play at least four matches in west London where large Ukrainian population is located; Blues able to accommodate Shakhtar after missing out on Europe themselves Friday 21 August 2026 16:43, UK Image: Ukrainian champions Shakhtar will play their European home games at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season Shakhtar Donetsk will play their Champions League home games at Stamford Bridge this season after coming to an agreement with Chelsea to host their European matches while they remain in exile from their Donbas Arena home. The Ukrainian side had been looking for a new temporary base for their continental games and had been linked with holding them at Brentford's Gtech Community Stadium, but will instead travel several miles towards central London to Chelsea's 40,044-capacity home. At the time of the last UK census in 2021, an estimated 19,000 Ukrainians lived in London while around 45,000 have since arrived in the capital since the Russian invasion of Ukraine began in 2022 with a high proportion settled in west London where Stamford Bridge is located.
